name: Naboth
bio: Naboth the Jezreelite owned a vineyard next to Ahab's palace in Jezreel. When Ahab offered to buy it or trade a better vineyard for it, Naboth refused on principle: "The LORD forbid it me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers unto thee" — honoring the law's protection of ancestral land (1 Kings 21:1-3). Jezebel then had the elders and nobles of his own city frame him: they proclaimed a fast, seated him publicly, and produced two false witnesses who accused him of cursing God and the king, after which the city stoned him to death on her orders (1 Kings 21:7-13). His murder brought Elijah's curse down on Ahab and Jezebel — that dogs would lick Ahab's blood where they had licked Naboth's, and would eat Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel (1 Kings 21:17-19, 23).
